claim: Moyasar amounts are in the smallest currency unit and an invoice can be in any ISO-4217 currency (1.00 KWD = 1000)
evidence: https://docs.moyasar.com/api/invoices/01-create-invoice (fetched 2026-10-07): 'ISO-4217 three-letter currency code'; 'A positive integer representing the payment amount in the smallest currency unit'; examples '1.00 SAR = 100', '1.00 KWD = 1000', '1 JPY = 1'.

claim: A partial refund leaves Moyasar's payment status 'paid' (assumed by the new order_resolve test helper and by the PAYMENT_REVERSED condition on provider_status 'refunded')
evidence: https://docs.moyasar.com/docs/guides/payment-operations/index.md (fetched 2026-10-07): 'To refund less than the charged amount, pass the amount parameter ... The payment status changes to refunded.'; refunds allowed from paid and captured. The project's emulator models the same by default (partialRefundKeepsPaid: false).

claim: The variant form's paid file may be up to 100 MB («PDF أو EPUB، حتى 100 ميغابايت.»)
evidence: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/storage/uploads/file-limits (fetched 2026-10-07): Free plan '50 MB', Pro '500 GB', global limit set in Storage Settings. False on a Free project; already reported as wave B OPS-PRIVACY-11, so no new finding here.

claim: Moyasar refunds only payments in status paid or captured (so a refund sent for a voided payment is refused)
evidence: https://docs.moyasar.com/docs/guides/payment-operations/index.md (fetched 2026-10-07): Quick Reference lists refunds from paid and captured; 'For paid payments, the maximum refundable amount is the full amount. For captured payments ... the captured amount.' Whether a second refund on a 'refunded' payment is accepted is not documented.
